summary.text: Mike Aylesworth (Michael J. Aylesworth on Ballotpedia) is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who has represented District 11 since November 2014 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His professional background includes farming and work at the Indiana Department of Environmental Management.

paragraphs.text: Aylesworth graduated from Hebron High School, attended St. Joseph College and Indiana University, and earned an M.A. from Valparaiso University.
His professional experience includes working as owner and operator of Aylesworth Farms and as director of the Northern Regional District Office of the Indiana Department of Environmental Management.
Aylesworth took office in the Indiana House on November 5, 2014.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
